text: FAA guidance: AC 107-2A discusses loss of control link and emergency/contingency procedures, but it does not establish a universal return‑to‑home (RTH) requirement for every drone. Manuals: DJI Matrice 210 V1 specifies Failsafe RTH activates automatically after signal loss (three seconds) and that the user can cancel to regain control; it also notes multiple RTH modes. Incident reports (unverified accounts): Autel EVO Max 4N reports claim all RTH attempts failed and a loss of control, while DJI Matrice 210 V1 reports indicate a failsafe entry with auto landing and limited response to command inputs. Main gap/conflict: conflicting evidence on whether failsafe RTH reliably returns the aircraft, and whether a mandatory universal RTH exists.
